{"consolidated_memory":"INFINITE RECURSION IN graph/traversal/walker.rs - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

SHARED CHARACTERISTICS:
- Component: graph/traversal/walker.rs (graph engine)
- Symptom: Infinite recursion causing stack to grow until guard trips
- Repro: Walk the cyclic fixture graph
- Test location: Module test block in graph/traversal/walker.rs
- Stack language: Rust

INCIDENT 1 [2026-05-24] - Transaction Race Condition
- Trigger: Two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: Two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR: #6612 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-5
- Result: Error rate dropped from 7.9% to under 4 per 10,000

INCIDENT 2 [2026-08-21] - Floating Point Arithmetic
- Trigger: Only appeared for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR: #9979 on branch fix/infinite-recursion-8
- Result: Reclaimed 34 GB of blob storage"}
